name: multiverse-mayhem
description: Multiverse Mayhem: an unofficial Rick and Morty fan game in cartoon 3D. Web game, online server and Android app (Capacitor).

scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
